text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Kawakami-chan!
Would it be okay if I cheer for you in your next race?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but of course!
I shall inform you of the date later!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Kawakami-senpai is running
in an upcoming race...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All-out dash! Cafeteria lady!
Please give me one yakisoba pan~!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Kawakami-chan!!
Give it your all in training today too!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Kawakami-san's cornering just now?
*sigh*... Her footwork is so cool~.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAH!
It's a butterflyyy~~~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah♪ Look how powerful she is!
That power is the secret to her speed...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Let's do our best too!
We won't lose! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Looking around...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that I'm looking for something...
It's just that lately, I've felt eyes on me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Probably because she has delivered results
worthy of such praise.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Think back, Kawakami.
Just which race was it that you won?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Umm... the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, and...
No, first... we should start with...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: There are so many of them...!
choice_data_list: The Hanshin JF and the Tiara route are options too.
The Hanshin JF and the Tiara route are options too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! That's right!
And the Victoria Mile too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, you have claimed every single crown
sought by those who walk the Tiara path."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It would be stranger if seeing this didn't make
more Umamusume look up to you as a role model.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your juniors aren't the only ones watching you.
Although, it seems you haven't realized that yet...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...? Whatever is the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You were so focused on running through,
you hardly notice the impact you've left
unless someone points it out to you, do you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your juniors weren't the only ones
inspired by you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Air Groove-senpai.
You've had a declaration of war thrown your way, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Seeing that back,
there's no one who wouldn't be inspired.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the same true for you?
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes... Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...H-Hyawawa...
A declaration of war from Air Groove-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This development... Was it in "Precure☆Returns"...
no, "Precure☆'s [Stars]" or not...?
choice_data_list: Doesn't really matter whether it's there or not, does it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: All I have to do is keep doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is a very simple
and easy-to-understand answer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will continue to
shine brightly as a princess!
